name: MEPPreIssue
description: Checks before an MEP issue, in order: the drawing-production doctor (catalogue, stamps, title blocks, numbering drift), ISO 19650 sheet compliance, every model validator (connectivity, fill, spec, termination, slope …), tag validation, and match-line validation (a renumber breaks the sheet references in match-line captions). Read-only apart from what each check records; run Heal Title Blocks and Renumber only if something here is reported.
